author: bilarion
message:
This paradigm that you mention, where it is much easier to obtain a role that you want by going through another company’s hiring process rather than your own company’s promotion process, is exactly what job hopping is about, where one maximizes his/salary gains through changing jobs every ~2-3 years.
I really liked the way you described that, though, about the duality of the promotion process and how it's related to the above, hadn't really thought of that in this way.
I will definitely be reading more of your stuff Dan ☺️
